definition: Consolidated total assets at December 31.
Gross loans and leases before allowance, excluding accrued interest; held-for-sale loans excluded. Verified against 2025 consolidated balance sheet.
Consolidated deposits at December 31.
BOA balance-sheet cash and cash equivalents. Broader taxonomy name includes restricted cash; use issuer label, not an unrestricted liquidity claim. Verified in 2025 balance sheet.
Annual net income attributable to parent, before preferred dividends.
BOA annual GAAP total revenue net of interest expense; not gross interest plus fee income.
GAAP net interest income; not fully taxable equivalent (FTE).
Loan and lease write-offs net of recoveries; positive denotes credit losses.
Funded loan/lease provision; negative denotes reserve release. Not total provision alone.
Credit-loss provision for unfunded lending commitments, added to funded provision.
Funded loan/lease allowance; numerator for allowance-to-loans ratio.
Allowance for unfunded lending commitments.
Total parent shareholders equity, including preferred equity.
Preferred equity carrying value including paid-in capital.
BOA trading account assets; does not include separately presented derivative assets.
BOA trading account liabilities; derivatives are separately presented.
Annual noninterest expense for GAAP efficiency calculation.
Capital Management / regulatory capital table: consolidated corporation, standardized approach, year-end. Do not substitute bank subsidiary or advanced approach.
